key_claims.claim: A co-learning NLP framework can systematically map pharmacotherapy knowledge gaps for pregnant, breastfeeding, and pediatric populations by mining 38 million PubMed abstracts.
Multimodal AI combining clinical, ECG, echocardiographic, and CT data predicts long-term mortality after TAVI more accurately than standard risk scores.
Five years after COVID-19 pneumonia, quantitative CT and hyperpolarized xenon-129 MRI reveal persistent ventilation defects and fibrotic changes not seen in healthy controls.
Bosniak v2019 classification and nodule size predict cancer risk in cystic renal masses but are less reliable for predicting unfavorable histology.
A deep learning model analyzing dual-modality ultrasound video can distinguish benign from malignant superficial lymphadenopathy and subclassify malignancies.
